title: Bind remote approvals to WebAuthn and existing ControlPlane receipts
head: c525cbe472df524446d166bdad4282269d73938c

enrollment_origin_policy.citation: docs/personal-os/contracts.md remote approval table: principal absent -> active is local Linux ControlPlane owner enrollment only; remote self-enrollment has no authority
enrollment_origin_policy.gateway_behavior: The security page shows that enrollment is unavailable on the gateway origin and does not call the local enrollment route from that origin. Registration and approval ceremonies still submit server-issued options to Linux.

blockers.B1: early-phase rejections audit in their own transaction; expired challenges are marked terminal
blockers.B2: shipped security page calls navigator.credentials.create and navigator.credentials.get; credential list and revocation staging use the Linux API; the client does not mint or verify receipts
blockers.B3: compose loads the sealed decision signing key through readEd25519PrivateKeyFile; readiness is ready only on a matching key, otherwise signer_unconfigured, signer_unsealed, or signer_mismatch; the resolver looks up the staged ControlPlane request; the phone gateway proxies /api/v1/remote-approvals/*, registration ceremonies, credential reads, and /security

gate_notes.audit_flags: rejection audits record authenticator up/uv bits when an assertion body is present; missing UV is uv=0
gate_notes.policy_ttl: challenge, registration, reservation, begin, and activation expiries read the parsed policy fields
gate_notes.prose_pins: removed the source-text pin in remote-approval-task36-receipts.test.ts

red.expired_audit: fail-closed expiry returned no audit row and left the challenge issued
red.replay_audit: control-plane replay left the audit count at 1
red.readiness: compose readiness reason was signer with no configured key
red.security_page: createBrowserSecurityClient resolved options without calling navigator.credentials.get
red.gateway_route: GET /security was not an allowed phone route

green.dashboard: 3 files, 8 tests passed, zero React warnings in the run output
green.playwright: 4 passed in e2e/remote-approval-page.spec.ts using CDP WebAuthn.enable and addVirtualAuthenticator; ceremonies were page-driven

qa.tool: Playwright remote-chromium plus CDP WebAuthn.enable and WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator (UV true)
qa.happy: security page enroll then approve one staged recommendation; one receipt; one executor claim; second claim refused
qa.touch_id: not tested; real Touch ID is outside this automated gate

preexisting: dashboard-policy-startup health probes can time out at 5000ms because api-routes falls back to the runtime Second Brain probe. Not changed and not counted as a Task 35 failure.
